messages.subject: Summer Bayesian SEM course
parts:
Hi all

I am here to announce a Summer course that may be of interest. I am teaching a Bayesian SEM course as part of the Stats Camp in Albuquerque New Mexico this June 12-16.
The example and code for class are provided with blavaan and JAGS (if interested in using other software we can provide support). The course focus in application and understanding of the SEM in the Bayesian framework, with examples of different models. There is consultation time to work on example code or models of interest with your data with our support and help

For more information please visit the website below, and feel free to ask me questions

https://www.statscamp.org/summer-camp/advanced-sem

Thanks
